title: Jennifer Lopez Says a Monster-in-Law Sequel With Jane Fonda Is Being Discussed
excerpt:
Lopez has teased conversations about revisiting the 2005 romantic comedy.
No sequel has been officially greenlit.
body_md:
Jennifer Lopez has suggested that a follow-up to the 2005 romantic comedy Monster-in-Law could reunite her with Jane Fonda. Speaking in a preview of The Drew Barrymore Show, she recalled enjoying their work together and said discussions about another film have taken place.

The original film featured Fonda as Viola Fields, a prospective mother-in-law determined to prevent her son from marrying Lopez's Charlotte. Michael Vartan, Wanda Sykes, Adam Scott and Will Arnett were also part of the cast.

The two actresses have remained friendly since the production. Fonda spoke at Lopez's Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony in 2013, and the pair were photographed together at a pre-Oscars event in 2025.

The interview also touched on Lopez's recent Barbarella-inspired Halloween costume, a nod to one of Fonda's best-known screen roles.

Lopez is promoting The JLo Show, a concert film scheduled for CBS on November 26, 2026, followed by Paramount+ streaming. The potential Monster-in-Law sequel remains a conversation rather than an announced project, with no confirmed production timetable.
